method.percentiles: p50 median; p95 linearly interpolated empirical quantile
method.verification: outside timed interval; exact file bytes, tree count, native modes and ns mtime
method.reset: outside timing; per-sample input generation and existing incorrect destinations (warm replacement, not a fresh-file benchmark)

io.measurement: Source CLI wall time, telemetry off; fixture setup and verification excluded

method.roundtrip: client write/flush to parsed server response; persistent native process
method.startup: LSP initialization includes process creation; other requests exclude startup
method.repl_copy: versioned literal overwrite with atomic publication; bytes checked after response
method.repl_scalar: expression result bytes checked for each frozen Native AOT image
method.lsp_edit: didChange flush through current-type hover response; no readiness wait outside timing
method.lsp_delta: didChange through negotiated delta; reconstruction checked against independent positions and current full response outside timing

editor.measurement: fresh LSP session per observation; individual request and complete edit-burst clocks remain distinct

clock_calibration.scope: 4096 adjacent counter-read deltas before product launch; descriptive overhead, never subtracted

session.measurement: Enter to verified result and next rendered prompt; typing outside timer
session.render_measurement: Paste write to first observed complete input text; separate from Enter to next ready prompt
